title: Picking customers keeps work orders where they are customer or Bill To
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the asset's current owner.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, the asset's earlier owner.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, a payer.
  • Have a new asset for this test, asset 1, now owned by customer A, that earlier belonged to customer C, with work order 1 for customer C billing itself and work order 2 for customer A billed to customer B, both at the test location.
custom_steps:
1. Open asset 1's Work Orders tab from customer A's page.
  2. Click the "Customer" filter chip.
  3. Tick customer B.
  4. Tick customer C.
  5. Apply the filter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • 2 rows are listed.

Step 2:

  • The options show.

Step 3:

  • The chip shows "1 selected".

Step 4:

  • Two customers are ticked.

Step 5:

  • Work order 2 is listed (customer B is its Bill To) and work order 1 is listed (customer C is its customer): 2 rows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12316 (Story 14, Asset Work Orders tab: whole history and Customer filter)

  • S14-R4: “The filter is multi-select; a work order matches when a picked customer is its customer or its Bill To.”
  • Key Decisions: “The asset's Work Orders tab shows its whole history at the current location by default, with a Customer filter matching the customer or the Bill To.”
